reference_method: V8 crops and scan page were manually transcribed and visually checked from source renders. The 2011 income statement was manually transcribed, visually reviewed and key figures cross-checked against the issuer annual report. The two 2011 balance sheets were transcribed with PDF text-layer assistance and visually checked.
protocol: Copy each selected region from its source PDF page, rasterize it at 216 DPI to remove any embedded OCR text layer, then run the existing DocumentProcessor PDF upload path (PyMuPDF/Tesseract fallback) with separate page-text and numeric-table render scales. Score manually transcribed text and reviewed financial row/value anchors.
limitations: Production-parser OCR path only. This supplemental set contains three pages from one third-party Vietnamese scan packet and manually reviewed financial anchors; it is diagnostic, not representative model-selection evidence or safe automatic financial publication. It scores label/value association but has no separately annotated cell coordinates or paired OCR-engine comparison. Throughput includes parser/OCR invocation but excludes application embedding and database persistence.

This Regulation applies to: Board members, the Chief Executive Director ("CEO”), Executive Directors, the Company Secretary, the Corporate Governance Officer, and other relevant individuals and departments. This Regulation governs matters relating to: a. Roles, rights and obligations of the General Meeting of Shareholders (“the GMS”), the Board, the CEO and Committees under the Board; b.
Procedures and formalities for meetings of the GMS and meetings of the Board; c Nomination, candidacy, election, removal and dismissal of Board members, the CEO and members of Committees; Coordination of activities between the Board and the CEO; Provisions relating to annual evaluation, rewards and disciplinary actions applicable to Board members, the CEO and Executive Directors; and Other activities as provided for in the Charter and other applicable provisions of law. 12.
